title: 2026 Summer Intern, PhD, Research, World Modeling Evaluation
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The mission of the Waymo AI Foundations team is to develop machine learning solutions addressing open problems in autonomous driving, towards the goal of safely operating Waymo vehicles in dozens of cities and under all driving conditions. As part of our work, we also initiate and foster collaborations with other research teams in Alphabet. AI Foundations areas that we are currently focusing on include reinforcement learning, learning from demonstration, generative modeling, Bayesian inference, hierarchical learning, and robust evaluation.

Waymo interns partner with leaders in the industry on projects that create impact to the company. We believe learning is a two-way street: applying your knowledge while providing you with opportunities to expand your skill-set. Interns are an important part of our culture and our recruiting pipeline. Join us at Waymo for a fun and rewarding internship!

 

You will:

• Solve research problems in world modeling and reasoning in autonomous driving systems

• Prototype and iterate research ideas

• Present research findings to a wide audience within Waymo, with the goal of publishing results to the research community

You have:

• Currently enrolled in a PhD program in Computer Science, Robotics, or a similar technical field of study

• Research experience in computer vision and machine learning

• Strong programming skills in Python

We prefer:

• First-authored publications from top-tier Computer Vision, graphics, or robotics conferences

• Research experience in generative models or large language models

• Hands-on experience with deep neural networks and familiarity with at least one type of deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, Jax, Tensorflow, etc.

 

Note: This will be a hybrid onsite internship position. We will accept resumes on a rolling basis until the role is filled. To be in consideration for multiple roles, you will need to apply to each one individually - please apply to the top 3 roles you are interested in.
The expected hourly rate for this full-time position is listed below. Interns are also eligible to participate in the Company’s generous benefits programs, subject to eligibility requirements.

Hourly PhD Pay
$85 — $85 USD

title: Marketing Analytics Manager
description:
About impact.com
impact.com is the world’s leading commerce partnership marketing platform, transforming the way businesses grow by enabling them to discover, manage, and scale partnerships across the entire customer journey. From affiliates and influencers to content publishers, brand ambassadors, and customer advocates, impact.com empowers brands to drive trusted, performance-based growth through authentic relationships. Its award-winning products - Performance (affiliate), Creator (influencer), and Advocate (customer referral) - unify every type of partner into one integrated platform. As consumers increasingly rely on recommendations from people and communities they trust, impact.com helps brands show up where it matters most. Today, over 5,000 global brands - including Walmart, Uber, Shopify, Lenovo, L’Oréal, and Fanatics - rely on impact.com to power more than 350,000 partnerships that deliver measurable business results.
Your Role at impact.com:
Impact.com powers the partnership economy, helping brands and partners grow revenue through a modern SaaS platform used by thousands of companies globally. We're investing heavily in our growth, and this role sits at the centre of how data powers our go-to-market strategy and sales enablement. We're looking for an Analytics Manager to scale our marketing function. This is a senior individual contributor role - we need someone who’s comfortable owning a domain of the marketing analytics portfolio with light oversight.
As Marketing Analytics Manager, you'll own the quality, consistency, and strategic impact of the core reporting used by our GTM teams to shape and prioritize multimillion dollar investment decisions. You'll work on a modern cloud stack (BigQuery, dbt, Looker) with strong support from Marketing and Sales teams - who will be your chief internal customers, and Analytics Engineering, who own the data platform and semantic layer you work with and on.
What You'll Do:

• Own the process for the weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews that marketing and sales leaders use to track campaign performance and business trends - and improve them over time so they drive decisions rather than descriptions.

• Translate vague business questions ("why is pipeline soft in EMEA?") into workable analyses, sell a solution, and manage the delivery process efficiently.

• Partner with internal customers and engineers to move recurring manual reporting into useful tools that drive decisions which save time and money.

• Work directly with stakeholders across marketing, sales, finance, product, and customer success to scope what they actually need and design a plan to get them that information efficiently and with the right level of accuracy.

• Contribute to data collection and modeling conversations where marketing's needs intersect with the broader company data model.

What You Bring:

• 5+ years of business analytics experience in a software or information business.

• A strong understanding of SQL and working proficiency with Python - enough to do your own analysis end-to-end without needing outside help.

• A track record of designing dashboards and reports that people use to actually make decisions, and a sense of taste on what makes the difference between decisive reporting and vague reporting.

• Ability to explain an analysis or technical concept to colleagues in a way that drives action.

• Comfortable owning a workstream end-to-end with light oversight: you'll get direction on weekly priorities and outcomes, but will be trusted to set your own week and say no to the right things.

Nice to Have:

• Experience with attribution modeling - multi-touch, time decay, incrementality

• Experience with lead scoring

• Experience with integration of sales and marketing data and a full-funnel perspective

• Experience with dbt, databricks, Looker, or another data management tool

• Experience in partnership marketing, digital marketing, or performance marketing

Salary Range: $80,000

title: Manager, Brand Engagement - WWF International
description:
Want to make a positive difference to the future of people and our one shared home, the Earth? Working at WWF could be your opportunity of a lifetime.
All around the world, people are waking up to the devastating impacts of climate change and nature loss. The situation today is worse than the darkest predictions of just ten years ago, pushing billions of people to the edge and threatening lives and livelihoods. At WWF, we are facing our biggest crisis - and our biggest ever opportunity - to create a better future for people and nature. With over 60 years of experience and an active presence in more than 100 countries, we work to achieve both on-the-ground and global policy action, from protecting and restoring species and their habitats, to transforming markets and policies toward sustainability.
Our people come from hugely diverse backgrounds and with a variety of expertise, ranging from conservation science and advocacy to HR and finance. We welcome applications from anyone who believes they can help us tackle this enormous global challenge and drive the urgent conservation impact needed to restore our planet.
What We Do We are an independent conservation organization, striving to sustain the natural world for the benefit of people and the ecosystem. From individuals and communities to businesses and governments, we are part of a growing global movement calling for bolder action on climate and nature, demanding that world leaders set nature on the path to recovery by 2030. WWF works to address the most dominant drivers of nature loss through system-wide changes in how food and energy are produced and consumed, and in how financial systems are structured. By implementing change in every country, we aim to drive visible and positive impacts on the ground, helping to restore nature in the most critical places around the world, from the Amazon to the Coral Triangle.
Engaging everyone means addressing the barriers to participation faced by some groups in society, including local communities. Conservation will only be sustainable if it is owned by, and benefits, local people. That’s why Indigenous Peoples and local communities must be at the centre of action on climate and nature. WWF is committed to using its resources and global network to support these communities in creating together the most effective solutions where they live.
Humanity is still in time, we have a clear pathway to solve this crisis. At WWF, we call on everyone to join the global movement, change how we live, and take action now.

title: AI & Biosecurity Research Resident
description:
Job Type:
Term (Fixed Term) Overview
RAND’s Center on AI, Security, and Technology (CAST), part of the Global and Emerging Risks (GER) Division conducts cutting-edge research on transformative, high-impact technologies-including artificial intelligence and biotechnology-to shape policies that protect global security and advance the public good.
Your work will address key questions related to global and emerging AI and biosecurity risks, understanding options for prevention and resilience, and examining their policy implications.
You will communicate the results of your work to both technical and non-technical audiences through quick-turnaround policy briefs and detailed written research products. A recent example of one of our research products is the Synthesis Screening report, which examined the current state of nucleic acid synthesis screening and offered recommendations for policymakers and industry leaders to further secure these technologies.
RAND's reputation for excellence is built on our commitment to high-quality, rigorous analysis and objectivity. In this role, you will apply quantitative and qualitative skills to rigorously analyze AI and biosecurity problems of national and international importance.
Qualifications
All research positions at RAND require excellent analytic skills; the ability to communicate clearly and effectively, both orally and in writing; the ability to work effectively as a member of a multi-disciplinary team; and a strong commitment to RAND's core values of quality and objectivity.
In addition, successful applicants will have:

• Experience in nucleic acid synthesis, AI-enabled biodesign, dual-use research of concern, potential pandemic pathogens, personal protective equipment, bioterrorism, or pathogen agnostic biosurveillance preferred.

• Demonstrated knowledge and ability to analyze or implement policies involving strategy, doctrine, operations, tactics, systems or organization.

• Ability for quantitative analysis and modeling, including modeling of uncertainty.

• Experience in government, intelligence community, or other relevant decision-making offices preferred, but not required.

• Ability to present evidence of research experience, demonstrated through authorship of academic publications, conference presentations, or prior professional reports.

Education & Experience Requirements
RAND is hiring multiple AI & Biosecurity Research Residents at the Associate, Specialist, and Expert levels of experience.
Minimum education and experience requirements at the Associate level include:
A PhD in Statistics, Biostatistics, Biology, Physics, Chemistry, Geology, or other natural and physical sciences is required - OR - PhD or equivalent in Policy Analysis or any technical discipline, Health Services Management, Public Health, Epidemiology or Business, with demonstrable proficiency in formal methods of decision support analysis is required.
OR
A Master’s degree in the fields listed above with at least 3 years of relevant professional experience, is required.
OR
A Bachelor’s degree in the fields listed above with at least 5 years of relevant professional experience, is required.
Security Clearance
Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government clearance is preferred but not required.
Location
We are hiring for this position in San Francisco, CA; Washington, DC; Santa Monica, CA; Pittsburgh, PA; and Boston, MA. We offer a hybrid work arrangement, combining work from home and on-site options. Fully remote work will also be considered.

A writing sample of 3 pages or more is required for this position. Applicants are encouraged to use recent pieces that have been published in academic or other journals, but may use master’s theses or papers written for coursework, prior employment, or internships.

This position is a 3-year term appointment with a possibility of renewal, alongside options for longer term employment.

title: Medical Director
description:
Reimagine the infrastructure of cancer care within a community that values integrity, inspires growth, and is uniquely positioned to create a more modern, connected oncology ecosystem. We’re looking for a Medical Director to help us accomplish our mission to improve and extend lives by learning from the experience of every person with cancer. Are you ready to be the next changemaker in cancer care?
A note on level: We're open to candidates at the Associate Medical Director or Medical Director level depending on experience and scope of prior ownership in precision medicine.
What You'll Do
Flatiron Health is looking for a data-and technology-oriented clinician with oncology subject matter expertise who is passionate about real-world evidence (RWE) accelerating progress against cancer. You will be part of the Global Research Oncology team that operates across the US, UK, Germany, and Japan.
In this role you will collaborate with a cross-functional team of oncologists/clinicians, data scientists, epidemiologists, software engineers, product managers, account directors, and clinical data specialists to help develop, commercialize, and deliver our oncology research data and services leveraging a breadth of tools, including artificial intelligence. You will serve as a core medical resource with a particular focus in precision medicine and cancer genomics. You will also help biopharma clients apply clinical and molecular use cases across the full R&D lifecycle-from early pipeline discovery through post-market clinical development. In addition you will:

•
Clinical Oncology & Precision Medicine Expert: Serve as a core medical expert unblocking high-volume, custom data requests across oncologic diseases including rare tumor types and complex, multi-omic biomarker profiles. Flexibly pivot across oncologic disease areas to scope, design, and clinically validate custom datasets and analyses for our biopharma partners.

•
Translational Oncology & Discovery Partner: Partner with clients early in their R&D lifecycle to show how clinical-molecular datasets can fuel target discovery, characterize novel biomarker-defined cohorts, evaluate tumor biology, and guide combination therapy approaches. Help researchers validate preclinical hypotheses in real-world cohorts and explore clinical trial findings via reverse translation.

•
Clinical Development Translation: Apply clinical development and trial design principles to help biopharma clients bridge the gap between traditional clinical endpoints and real-world evidence (RWE). Help clients understand how real world data can support external control arms, historic cohorts, or synthetic control designs for niche or rare trial populations.

•
Commercial Pre-Sales & Scoping Subject Matter Expert: Proactively provide clinical and molecular data expertise to support teams during pre-sales, client scoping, and solution building utilising internal or off-the-shelf external AI tools. Partner with scientific and commercial leaders to translate a client’s clinical development planning, target validation, or complex inclusion/exclusion criteria into precise data specifications across our various data assets.

•
Cross-Functional Solutioning: Partner closely with matrixed project teams to apply established clinical-molecular frameworks to complex dataset deliveries and custom client requests.

•
Internal Capability Building: Support the development of internal training resources and clinical documentation to help upskill delivery teams on rare biomarker cohorts and molecular data structures.

•
Scientific Contribution: Participate in research study projects requiring physician expertise with support from senior leaders, including presenting or speaking at scientific conferences.

Who You Are
You're a kind, passionate, and collaborative problem-solver who values the opportunity to think beyond the way things are. In addition, you are an oncologist with post training experience in clinical, academic or industry set

title: Program Financial Analyst, AD&S
description:

Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Autonomous Airpower (AA) business line develops and manufactures next-generation unmanned aircraft for U.S. and allied air forces. The AA program finance team is embedded with engineering, program management, and operations to ensure that every dollar of contract value is planned, executed, and reported with discipline. We are building a modern program controls function from the ground up: fast-moving, data-driven, and tightly integrated with the technical teams actually building the aircraft.

title: Senior Web Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT HIYA

At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.

Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.

Hiya is hiring a Senior Web Marketing Manager to define and lead how our marketing website shifts and scales in the era of an AI-enabled buyer’s journey. Buyers will increasingly meet Hiya through AI answers before they ever land on the site, and this role decides what our site becomes in that world. You’ll drive how Hiya’s web properties influence what buyers know, discover, and decide about Hiya on and off site, with a north star goal to deliver high quality conversions and sales pipeline.

This is a performance- and analytics-driven marketing role at the center of our demand engine. You'll translate positioning and campaign strategy into high-converting web experiences, own the conversion-rate-optimization program end to end, and make the website a measurable driver of qualified demand across every market we operate in.

You'll partner closely with our GTM Engineer, who owns the “how” of the website (platform, architecture, and technical build). You’ll own the “what and why” - roadmap, priorities, experience, discoverability, conversion, and localization.

We're looking for someone who understands buyer psychology and funnel performance as deeply as they understand web best practices. You work deeply with and alongside AI and have a strong curiosity and drive to incorporate new uses for AI into your workflow. You’re a marketer who is fluent with martech, obsessed with conversion, and able to lead cross-functional teams and agencies to a best-in-class website.

In the near term, you’ll run a post-migration content audit and decide what we keep, consolidate, cut and expand upon to meet our 2027 goals.

Build and run the CRO program: develop hypotheses and testing roadmaps, run A/B tests and personalization, and continuously optimize top pages and full-funnel journeys to increase experimentation velocity. Own metrics definitions that inform our Amplitude instance.

- Campaign & landing-page execution. Translate campaign and positioning strategy into compelling landing pages and web experiences, and work with engineering to build the page systems that let demand and audience marketing teams deploy campaigns quickly.

- UX, messaging & experience quality. Champion best-in-class mobile and desktop experiences, messaging clarity, accessibility, and Core Web Vitals / performance standards.

- SEO/GEO. Own SEO & GEO strategy, in partnership with the content team for inputs to content strategy and implementation. title: Platform Engineer
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE SECURITY TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- You're securing the frontier of AI. The model weights training on our infrastructure are the most valuable and most targeted artifacts in technology, and we're standing up the compute to hold them faster than anyone ever has. A breach isn't a leak, it's the frontier walking out the door.

- Build the entire security program from scratch. Most leaders inherit someone else's system and spend a career patching it. Here you own it end to end, bare metal to boardroom, as we scale across continents.

- The industry's playbook was written for one building at a time. Vendor-managed appliances, manual process, and standards that assume a security team walks the floor. None of that survives contact with what we're building, so we build what should exist rather than buying what does.

- Your threat surface is measured in gigawatts. The customers running on our infrastructure are building the most consequential technology in human history, and being responsible for the physical and logical security of that work makes everything else feel small.

ROLE SCOPE

- Build the infrastructure as code that stands up a site's entire security platform, so bringing on a campus is a pipeline run rather than a project.

- Own CI/CD and the release path for the security stack, so every change reaches production tested, versioned, and reversible.

- Automate the remediation the team would otherwise do by hand, and hold the line that anything done twice becomes code.

- Build the package and patch pipeline that keeps a growing fleet current without a person touching a single host.

- Get the automation in place ahead of the platform it serves, so on-call stays something a small team can carry as campuses multiply.

Humana is committed to helping people achieve their best health by delivering innovative technology solutions that enable exceptional member and provider experiences.

The Associate Director, Segment Quality Engineering is a people and delivery leader responsible for executing quality engineering practices across a defined set of products, applications, or delivery teams within Humana ’s technology portfolio. Reporting to the AVP, Segment Quality Engineering, this role leads quality engineering teams focused on delivery quality, test automation, release readiness, and continuous improvement.

This leader will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Platform, DevOps, and enterprise quality teams to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle and improve release confidence, delivery speed, and production stability. The Associate Director will help operationalize segment quality strategy through consistent execution, strong team leadership, and measurable quality outcomes. Responsibilities

• Lead quality engineering execution for a defined set of applications, products, or agile teams within the segment portfolio.

• Manage, coach, and develop quality engineering leaders, engineers, and SDETs, with accountability for team performance, engagement, and growth.

• Implement quality engineering standards, practices, and governance established by segment and enterprise leadership.

• Drive quality planning and execution across functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, and release validation activities.

• Partner with Engineering, Product, and delivery leaders to ensure quality is embedded in planning, design, development, and release processes.

• Oversee defect management activities, including triage coordination, trend analysis, root cause follow-up, and corrective action tracking.

• Support release readiness assessments and ensure validation activities are completed for production deployments.

• Advance automation adoption across assigned teams, including sustainable regression coverage and improved testing efficiency.

• Help integrate automated validations and quality checks into CI/CD pipelines in partnership with engineering and platform teams.

• Coordinate non-functional quality support for assigned areas, including performance, resiliency, operational readiness, and security validation activities.

• Monitor quality metrics, delivery trends, and production outcomes to identify risks and continuous improvement opportunities.

• Escalate systemic quality concerns, portfolio risks, and capacity constraints to Director leadership as needed.

• Contribute to quality engineering modernization efforts through adoption of enterprise tools, reusable frameworks, and improved ways of working.

• Enable AI-assisted quality engineering within governed guardrails by piloting and scaling approved capabilities (e.g., test case generation assistance, risk-based prioritization insights, defect clustering/summarization, self-healing suggestions) to improve efficiency and signal quality.

• Promote responsible AI use on teams by ensuring AI outputs are validated, traceable where required, and aligned with security/privacy/compliance expectations; surface AI adoption learnings and needs to segment leadership.

Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

• 8+ years of experience in software engineering, quality engineering, testing, or related technical disciplines.

• 3+ years of leadership experience managing quality engineering, test automation, or software delivery teams in enterprise environments.

• Experience leading quality engineering activities across multiple agile teams or complex applications.

• Demonstrated experience improving quality engineering practices, including automation, process improvement, and metrics-based execution.

• Strong understanding of Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD practice

title: Business Analyst / Project Manager
description:
Business Analyst / Project Manager
Overview
We are recruiting on behalf of our client for a Business Analyst / Project Manager. Our client is a UK-based consultancy that works with small business owners to map, measure, and improve how their businesses operate. This role sits at the centre of every client engagement - managing projects through a structured five-stage methodology whilst maintaining the day-to-day client relationship from first conversation through to ongoing support.
The successful candidate will split their time between project management and hands-on business analysis, running process-mapping workshops with business owners and ensuring that nothing falls through the cracks across multiple concurrent engagements. This is a fully remote position requiring alignment with UK business hours (GMT/BST).
Key Responsibilities

• Manage multiple client projects simultaneously, tracking the status of each engagement and identifying what is progressing, what is blocked, and what needs immediate attention

• Own the client relationship day to day - serve as the primary point of contact, communicate progress clearly and honestly, and set realistic expectations on timing and effort

• Build and maintain detailed project plans and Gantt charts, keeping them accurate as scope, priorities, and deadlines evolve

• Facilitate workshops and one-to-one sessions with business owners to map end-to-end business processes, producing activity diagrams and flow charts in Miro using standard UML notation

• Co-ordinate actions, dependencies, and outstanding information across clients, consultants, bookkeepers, and management accountants - chasing what is overdue before it causes delay

• Identify gaps, bottlenecks, and risks early, raising concerns proactively with the client and the internal team rather than waiting to be asked

• Maintain clear records of decisions, actions, and owners after every client interaction, and keep overall project status visible to the wider team at all times

Requirements

• Matric (Grade 12) as a minimum; a BCom, National Diploma in Business Administration, or a relevant NQF Level 6-7 qualification is strongly preferred

• Demonstrated experience in a business analysis role, including requirements elicitation, process documentation, and assumption testing

• Hands-on project management experience running several projects concurrently, with a track record of delivering on time and communicating clearly when timelines change

• Proficiency in Miro or a comparable online whiteboard tool, alongside everyday collaboration tools such as task trackers, shared documents, and spreadsheets

• Confident working directly with clients or external stakeholders, ideally owners or senior leaders of small to medium-sized businesses

• Comfortable reading and discussing basic financial information - P&L statements, cash flow, and business performance figures - without needing to be a qualified accountant

Preferred Experience

• Prior exposure to financial services, accountancy practice, consulting, or finance operations

• Familiarity with Xero or similar cloud-based accounting software

• Experience supporting SMEs in sectors such as construction, e-commerce, or professional services

• A recognised qualification in project management or business analysis, such as PRINCE2, PMP, or a BABOK-aligned certification

Key Competencies
* Strong communication skills
* High attention to detail
* Strong organisational skills
* Ability to work independently
* Professionalism and reliability

We are building one of the world’s largest AI supercomputers from the ground up. As part of the Compute Infrastructure team, you will own both the raw GPU supercomputer and the platform layer that runs on top of it. You will work across the full stack - from low-level GPU kernel optimizations and Linux kernel internals to massive-scale orchestration and virtualization - to make training and inference at SpaceXSI as fast, reliable, and scalable as possible.
This is a broad, high-impact role that combines hardcore supercompute and compute infrastructure work. Your contributions will directly accelerate Grok’s training speed and overall AI progress.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Design, build, and optimize massive GPU clusters for extreme-scale training and inference workloads

• Develop and tune low-level CUDA kernels (GeMM, Attention, etc.), using CUTLASS, Tensor Cores, and Nsight for maximum performance

• Profile, debug, and eliminate bottlenecks across GPU memory hierarchy, networking fabric, filesystems, and multi-GPU operation

• Collaborate closely with AI research teams to deliver production-grade performance and scalability

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• 5+ years of experience with low-level system programming in C/C++

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Deep low-level systems programming (C/C++/PTX/SASS)

• Strong experience with large-scale GPU clusters or distributed compute infrastructure at production scale

• Hands-on work with GPU kernel optimization (CUTLASS, custom kernels, Nsight profiling)

• Track record of building or running high-performance infrastructure for AI workloads (training or inference platforms)

• Ability to reason from first principles and optimize for both memory-bound and compute-bound scenarios

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

$200,000 - $375,000 USD

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.
SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our  Recruitment Privacy Notice .

ЩО ТИ БУДЕШ РОБИТИ

ЩО МИ ОЧІКУЄМО

Hard skills:

- Глибоке володіння Python та SQL: від побудови production-ready рішень до оптимізації запитів під реальне навантаження

- Практичний досвід із ETL/ELT-оркестрацією (Airflow, Dataform або аналоги)

- Досвід роботи з хмарними платформами (GCP, AWS або Azure)

Підхід до роботи:

- Вмієш формулювати та відстоювати технічні рішення

- Готовий брати відповідальність за результат напрямку, а не тільки за свій код

- Проактивно підтягуєш колег - ділишся знаннями, робиш ревʼю, яке дає цінність

- Дієш як CEO у своїй ролі: бачиш картину цілком, не чекаєш задачі - формуєш порядок денний

Ми не прив'язані до стеку. Якщо ти вирішував схожі задачі іншими інструментами - розкажи як. Нам важливий твій підхід до проблем і здатність швидко розбиратись у технологіях та підходах.

БУДЕ ПЛЮСОМ

- Досвід на стороні аналітики (Data Analyst) - розумієш, що потрібно споживачам даних

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Difference You Will Make

You'll own campaigns end to end - creator sourcing, briefing, contracting, measurement and reporting - and help position influencers as both a commercial lever and a long-term driver of brand health, while collaborating with agency partners.

Sitting in the UK Communications team, you'll build influencer into campaign narratives from inception, and partner with Brand Marketing and Paid Media so creator content is designed for amplification from the outset,

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Staff Software Engineer (EMEA)
Zenrows is the web data infrastructure for AI. Founded in 2021, we give developers, AI agents and businesses one reliable way to access, extract and structure data from any website, at any scale, however hard the site tries to block them.
Whether it’s an agent that needs fresh web context mid-task, an LLM application grounded in live data, or an enterprise pipeline pulling millions of pages a day, Zenrows handles the rendering, the anti-bot defences and the parsing behind a single API, 10B+ requests a month. Teams at more than 10,000 companies, including Microsoft, Amazon, Dell, IBM, Slack, eBay, EY, Nokia and Clay, rely on Zenrows to turn the web into a reliable source of data for their products, workflows and AI-driven applications, across e-commerce, finance, real estate and AI.
As we continue our expansion, we are now looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join us on a permanent basis and make an instant impact, working directly with the CEO and CTO.
The Role
AI runs on web data, and more and more of the work that needs it is done by AI agents. Zenrows is how they get it. Fetch gets any page past the toughest anti-bot systems. Extract turns it into clean, structured data. Batch and Crawl do it across whole websites.
We’re also changing how software gets built. Our engineers already write 100% of their code with agents. We are moving more and more operational workflows from manual, to automated, to autonomous, trusting agents with real work in production. Very few teams are doing this for real. We are, and we want you to help lead it.

What You’ll Do

• You’ll own a customer-facing product end to end: what it does, how it runs, and the business number it moves. There are no product managers here. You talk to customers, decide what to build, build it with your agents, ship it, and own it.

• The problems are real. Our systems run on thousands of CPU cores, handle millions of requests a day, and stay ahead of anti-bot systems built by companies many times our size. You’ll design systems that hold up under that load. You’ll also build the tests, evals and guardrails that tell us when an agent’s work can be trusted.

• As a Staff Engineer, you’ll shape how the whole company works with agents. When one team finds a better way of working, you’ll help turn it into the standard for everyone.

• Your days aren’t prescribed. You’ll look across the company, find where you can add the most value and go after it.

What We're Looking For

• You’ve built high-load, complex production systems and you’ve set the technical direction that other engineers followed.

• You put product first. You talk about customers and business impact before code, and you can say clearly what your work changed for the business.

• You’re all in on AI-native engineering. You build with agents every day, and you know how to verify, test and take ownership of what they produce. Bonus points if you’ve built and shipped products that use LLMs or agents in production.

• You write clearly. We’re remote and our agents work from written context, so a good spec or decision record is worth as much as good code.

• You’re comfortable working with non-technical people. You can sit down with sales, GTM or operations colleagues, understand their problems and turn them into something that ships, no translator needed.

• You take ownership without being asked. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, happy to experiment, fail and argue for ideas, and you think like a co-founder.

• You pick the tool that serves the customer. Today that’s mostly Go, AWS, and Terraform, and you are open to learn new languages and tools quickly.

• A love of hands-on work. You’ll still champion collaboration via knowledge-sharing sessions, kickoffs, and cross-team reviews, but this is an IC role at its heart, focused on building and influence.

• Availability to work EMEA hours, as our team collaborates across European time zones.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Ditto is redefining how data moves at the edge. Our mission is to make it seamless for developers to build resilient, real-time applications, regardless of network conditions. Whether you're in a stadium, airplane, or remote military base, Ditto's peer-to-peer sync engine ensures devices stay connected and data stays consistent, even without internet. With more than $145 million in funding and trusted by organizations like Chick-fil-A, Delta Airlines, and the U.S. military, Ditto powers mission-critical experiences across aviation, retail, travel, hospitality, defense, and more. FDEs are elite, versatile engineers who work shoulder-to-shoulder with our most critical users to solve complex challenges in real time. Your primary mission is to radically decrease the time-to-value of our software by integrating it directly into the user's operational environment.

Because you see firsthand how our technology performs in the wild, you will also act as a crucial conduit, feeding technical insights and feature requirements back to our core product engineering team. Keep Program Management informed of customer impact, remediation status, and escalation needs.

This role requires backgrounds in the medical device industry, specifically prior roles in R&D, Manufacturing, Clinical, or QA/RA. Individuals in this role generally hold advanced degrees, e.g., Ph.D. or MSc. The successful candidate possesses knowledge and understanding of the challenges of a medical device manufacturer and is dedicated to sharing their experience and perspective in a professional and constructive manner. Our goal is to seek consensus on solutions while maintaining a focus on compliance.

Leading complex regulatory and technical projects, DEKRA is your global partner in the testing and certification of medical devices. We are one of the five largest Notified Bodies in the world for companies involved in the design, manufacturing, and distribution of medical devices, including high-risk and innovative medical devices and in-vitro diagnostic medical devices. DEKRA is a recognized auditing organization for the Medical Device Single Audit Program (MDSAP). This program is designed to allow a single audit for medical device manufacturers that is accepted in multiple regulatory jurisdictions. As an established, well-recognized certification body, we maintain a global network of offices and state-of-the-art laboratories, taking pride in supporting the worldwide access of medical products to markets including Europe, Taiwan, USA, UK, Canada, Brazil, Australia, and Japan.

What You’ll Do:

• Apply working knowledge of global regulatory frameworks to evaluate manufacturers’ processes and products.

• Manage a portfolio of approximately 7-12 client accounts, ensuring timely delivery of services and responsiveness to client needs.

• Prepare clear, accurate, and technically sound client reports within defined timelines.

• Present DEKRA ’s findings to clients using professional communication and presentation skills.

• Serve as a Level 2 or higher owner of 4-10 DEKRA knowledge modules, maintaining familiarity with assigned content.

• Work with minimal supervision while demonstrating the ability to assess regulatory compliance and escalate issues appropriately.

• Analyze regulatory requirements and make sound, supportable determinations regarding compliance pathways.

• Collaborate effectively with external consultants and cross-functional stakeholders to support project objectives.

What You’ll Bring:

• Bachelor’s degree (minimum) in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Medicine, Pharmacy, (Micro)biology, Biotechnology, Clinical Physics, or a related medical device discipline. (MS or PhD preferred but not required.)

• 5-10 years of experience in a similar role within a Notified Body/Accreditation Body environment, or a combination of education and relevant medical device industry experience.

Home to Anchorage Digital Bank N.A., the first federally chartered crypto bank in the U.S., Anchorage Digital also serves institutions through Anchorage Digital Singapore, Porto by Anchorage Digital , and other offerings.

With the evolving landscape of digital threats and an increasing volume of sophisticated attacks by malicious actors, we have a security policy mandating all new hires complete an in-person onboarding process - no exceptions . While our security and IT logistics require physical presence to protect our infrastructure from sophisticated global threats, this move is equally about our Village culture. We believe that a laptop can be shipped, but our culture cannot.

• Produce risk reports for senior management, risk committees and regulators.

• Make risk calls on thinly traded and volatile assets where historical data is limited and standard models need judgment and adjustment.

• Balance enabling business growth with protecting the firm’s capital, liquidity and regulatory standing.

You will report to the Senior Director Financial Analytics and Insights.

• Manage Adaptive Planning user access, roles, permissions, and security while maintaining appropriate data governance and internal controls, while monitoring system performance, data integrity, integrations, and user experience and proactively identify opportunities for improvement.
